results.name: hover lifts a wall flat and true-size, docked inside the frame; pins become ≥ 24 px cards with names ≥ 9 px; leaving lets it settle; the resting camera is untouched (floor ≥ 80 %)
floor → resting wall: dragging a card onto the north wall spring-loads it and the card lands where it was dropped (mapped, not a free slot); a second drop further along lands further along
on a lifted wall: move a pin along it, drop a pin on a pin to pile, click the pile to fan it along the wall, drag a card out of the fan onto the floor
wall → wall: a pin dragged from the lifted north wall onto the west wall's spine spring-loads the west wall (lifts while still dragging) and lands on it
no pin limit: 40 pins on the Widgets wall — rows unroll along it, the pan buttons and the wheel reach the last pin, and there is always an empty row to drop into
keyboard: focusing a wall lifts it at once, Tab reaches its pins, Alt+ArrowRight moves the focused pin on the wall (persisted), Esc settles the wall
phone 390×760 and the straight-down camera: a focused wall lifts inside the frame with ≥ 24 px pins and no text under 9 px; nothing is text at rest
touch (390×760, hasTouch): tapping a wall lifts it, a finger drag moves a pin along the lifted wall (persisted), tapping the floor settles it
opened wall at 1440: the pinboard is never narrower than its 840 px board (no sideways scroll)
axe-core on a lifted wall (dark + light): no serious or critical violations
